name: Research LinkedIn content topics
description: Generate authority-building LinkedIn topic ideas (AI when configured, else curated templates). Persists topics.json under data/content/<runId>/.

env.name: CONTENT_MAX_TOPICS
env.description: How many topic ideas to generate

env.name: CONTENT_CATEGORIES
env.description: Comma-separated focus areas (defaults to AI, SaaS, DevOps, …)

env.name: CONTENT_USE_AI
env.description: Use Cursor (CURSOR_API_KEY) or OpenAI-compatible API; else topic bank

env.name: CURSOR_API_KEY
env.description: Preferred: Cursor Agent SDK key for topic research

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional fallback if CURSOR_API_KEY is unset
